# RunComfy Face Swap

💳 Paid API required — Curated by Skill Harbor — an intent router for face and character swap on RunComfy: it picks between five routes based on your actual intent — Wan 2-2 Animate (default for video character swap, portrait + audio drives the new identity), Kling 2-6 Motion Control Pro (transfer the source video's motion onto a new character), GPT Image 2 Edit (multi-reference still swap, up to 10 images, compositional precision), Nano Banana 2 Edit (batch identity-preserving swap, 1–20 frames, same identity across a SKU gallery), and FLUX Kontext Pro (single image, single declarative instruction, describe the new face in prose when no reference exists). By @genmedia-labs, listed here with credit to its creator. Requires the `runcomfy` CLI and a RunComfy account with paid generation credits — every generation is billed. Honest caveats: face-swap is dual-use — the skill carries an explicit consent section and instructs the agent to refuse requests targeting real people without consent, or defamatory, sexually explicit or otherwise harmful synthetic media, but it does not gate inputs itself, so the responsibility rests with you; use it only with the rights to both the target face and the source media, on platforms that allow synthetic media. The skill runs shell commands (declared as `Bash(runcomfy *)`), so review what it runs. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
